navigation.notes: Keyboard, touch, language popup while scrolled, content-position stability, reduced motion and history return verified.

themes.default: Resolved shell theme; OS changes broadcast in system mode
themes.manualOverride: Demo choice remains local until next shell appearance change; explicit theme links remain valid. Same-color mode switches preserve subsequent native theme changes.
themes.state: Iframe theme updates preserve entered text and iframe URL; existing origin/window/resource checks remain in effect.
themes.exceptions: Fixed-palette legacy examples and static cover images retain original colors.

reproduce: After npm run build, serve with node scripts/serve.mjs --dist --base=/ui-design-atlas/ then run node scripts/capture-navigation-theme.mjs output/navigation-theme. ATLAS_CAPTURE_BASE can override the server URL.
evidenceEnvironment: Local production build in Chromium; these are not production deployment captures.
